summary: Shimmick Corp filed an 8-K on April 28, 2026 announcing the appointment of Sarah Tacker as Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer, effective immediately. The appointment is a new hire, not a forced departure, but is classified as a management change under the given strict criteria. Ms. Tacker will receive a $500,000 base salary, annual bonus target of 50% of base salary, a one-time RSU grant of $150,000 vesting in 30 days, and an annual RSU grant of $500,000 vesting over three years. This event is routine executive hiring; watch for any future departures or strategic shifts.
